campus_background_no_campus.why: The background harmonics upload, a measurement file the user uploads in the app, needs a campus with a PCC bus first; the user drafts the campus, then uploads the measurement.

campus_background_unreadable.why: The background harmonics upload, a measurement file the user uploads in the app, has a stored copy that no longer matches its record; the user removes it and uploads the measurement again.

campus_background_too_large.why: The background harmonics upload, a measurement file the user uploads in the app, refuses a file over the size cap; the user uploads a shorter measurement.

campus_background_invalid.why: The background harmonics upload, a measurement file the user uploads in the app, refuses an empty or too long source, a date that is not YYYY-MM-DD, a too long file name or a CSV that does not parse; the user fixes the field the message names.
